title: Annotation API NEL entity
description: One linked named entity mention returned in `nes` by the /api/nel/ and /api/ner-nel/ endpoints. Offsets are absolute in the submitted text. The keys are those of the previous TorchServe backend, frozen; the linking pipeline's own fields (`wkdata_qid`, `wkpedia_lg`, the Wikidata labels, the link-filter provenance) are served by the v2 entity routes. When the mention does not resolve to a Wikidata item (NIL link), `wkd_id` is null while the Wikipedia fields may still be set. The server sends every key listed here, with null when there is no value.

type.description: Entity type. A coarse-grained Impresso-HIPE type (`pers`, `loc`, `org`, `time`, `prod`) for entities found by NER. It is an empty string when the type is unknown: in the NEL marker form, or when a /nel/ request entity has no type. /nel/ echoes the type sent by the client, so other values are possible. A link-validation rule may replace the NER type with the linked item's class.

surface.description: Surface form of the mention as it occurs in the submitted text.

lOffset.description: Zero-based offset of the first character of the mention in the submitted text (inclusive). Frozen wire name.

rOffset.description: Zero-based offset just after the last character of the mention in the submitted text (exclusive). Frozen wire name.

scope.description: Part of the text the mention belongs to (`body`), or null.

wkd_id.description: Wikidata QID of the linked entity, or null when the mention did not resolve or a validation rule removed the link. Named `wkdata_qid` in v2.

wkpedia_pagename.description: Wikipedia page name of the linked entity, or null.

wkpedia_url.description: Wikipedia URL of `wkpedia_pagename`, or null. It is not URL-encoded and can contain spaces.

confidence_ner.description: Overall NER confidence of the mention, or null when not available (the marker form, or a /nel/ request entity without one).

confidence_nel.description: Confidence of the link: the per-token likelihood of the predicted title, length-normalised. Null when not available. The previous TorchServe backend sent the raw sequence likelihood here.

confidence_margin.description: Difference between the top-1 and top-2 beam-search scores, or null when only one candidate was computed.

entity_confidence.description: Confidence that the span is an entity mention, independent of its type, or null when not computed. Named `confidence_ner_entity` in v2.

type_confidence.description: Confidence in the predicted type, given that the span is a mention, or null when not computed. Named `confidence_ner_type` in v2.

function.description: For a person mention, its `function` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null. The current NER model does not produce it.

name.description: For a person mention, its `name` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null. The current NER model does not produce it.

title.description: For a person mention, its `title` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null. The current NER model does not produce it.

wkd_pred.description: Raw prediction of the linking model, as `title >> lang`.
